label: H.Res. 1507
title: Providing for the printing of a revised edition of the Rules and Manual of the House of Representatives for the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress.

items.snippet: This resolution requires the printing of a revised edition of the Rules and Manual of the House of Representatives for the 118th Congress.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.note: Not checked against lobbying filings (117th Congress bill; 2025-2026 filings are not searched for it).

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

H000874.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
H000874.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
H000874.note: No lobbying list to compare for this bill.
